name: nxvim-edithost-web
description: Web shell for the wasm edit-host: the Web Worker that owns core+Lua+OPFS (worker.mjs), the DOM renderer + input/mouse layer + window.__nxvim hook (index.html, with client-side tree-sitter highlighting via highlight.js), a cross-origin-isolated dev server (serve.mjs), the browser↔daemon WebTransport msgpack-RPC client (rpc.mjs, using the vendored @msgpack/msgpack), and the Playwright verifiers (verify.mjs = editor/transport/OPFS contract; verify-ui.mjs = renderer/mouse/selection/layout/highlighting; verify-fs.mjs = real local filesystem picker :eo/:wo/bare :w via the File System Access API; verify-shada.mjs = serverless shada persistence (registers/history) across a reload via OPFS; verify-daemon.mjs = the edit-host driving a real `nxvim --daemon --listen` over WebTransport). Build the wasm first with ../build.sh (which also vendors @msgpack/msgpack into vendor/).
